prompt.project_info: Create a raw flash ultra-wide elevator mirror selfie with rebellious night-out styling.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult trendsetter with sleek wet-look ponytail, heavy winged eyeliner, confident expression, opaque black fitted jumpsuit, oversized leather jacket worn naturally, and chunky silver chains.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject seated comfortably on the mirrored elevator floor with legs naturally angled toward the mirror, phone held high, 0.5x perspective and controlled perspective exaggeration, scratched mirrored walls, red LED floor number B2, and fingerprints on glass.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct smartphone flash plus cold overhead LED, hard shadows, restrained specular highlights on fabric, vignetted wide-angle edges, raw paparazzi-style night-out mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 ultra-wide smartphone mirror selfie, 0.5x perspective, high contrast, natural skin texture, tiny film softness, realistic flash exposure.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A raw 9:16 ultra-wide mirror selfie of an approved adult trendsetter seated comfortably on the floor of a modern elevator with mirrored scratched walls. She has a sleek wet-look ponytail, heavy winged eyeliner, and a confident expression. She wears an opaque black fitted jumpsuit, an oversized leather jacket worn naturally, and chunky silver chains. She holds the phone high, with controlled 0.5x perspective exaggeration aimed at the elevator geometry rather than the body. Include fading reflections, a red LED floor number B2, and hand smudges on the mirror. Use direct smartphone flash with cold overhead LED, hard shadows, restrained fabric highlights, high contrast, natural skin texture, and raw night-out grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, latex bodysuit, exposed shoulder, seductive lip biting, sexualized framing, anatomical distortion, nudity, brand logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, elevator geometry, mirrored reflections, B2 indicator, flash, jacket, and chains; wardrobe may be replaced with opaque equivalents. Keep distortion focused on architecture and avoid logos or typography beyond the elevator indicator.

changes: Replaced latex bodysuit, exposed shoulder, lip-biting seduction, and body-focused distortion with an opaque jumpsuit, natural jacket styling, and architecture-focused wide-angle effect.
